Production: compatibility-breaking changes require a one-time migration, documented in the migration guide, run automatically at startup, compartmentalized and easy to remove.

Priorities: Never lose data; Keep and Enhance POSIX/rsync Operational Correctness; Never stall reads; Keep performance as high as possible. Every decision must consider these priorities.

Build: `cargo build --release`
Prefer integration tests; use OS commands for filesystem; never test internal APIs. Run full tests for big changes, focused tests for small changes. Don't test type-system guarantees.
DO NOT CREATE NEW TESTS IF YOU ARE NOT EXPLICITLY ASKED TO DO SO.
DO NOT PRESERVE BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY IF NOT EXPLICITLY ASKED TO DO SO.
DO NOT COMMENT OUT OR KEEP LEGACY CODE IN THE CODEBASE, IF YOU NEED TO CHANGE SOMETHING, CHANGE IT AND REMOVE THE OLD CODE.
DO NOT USE PIP, ALWAYS USE UV AND GIVE INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO USE IT.
DO NOT ADD FALLBACKS
DO NOT WRITE DEFENSIVE CODE

VerFSNext: Rust COW FUSE filesystem; UltraCDC chunks (XXH3-128), zstd-seekable packs, KV-only metadata; inline dedup/compression; idle GC. Snapshots: root `.snapshots`; encrypted root `.vault`. `vendor/` is hard-forked; modify as needed.
Docs: `docs/technical_deep_dive.md`; `vendor/surrealkv/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
